text: What does your girlfriend look like, Tony?
Ella? Oh, she's tall. And she has long, dark brown hair.
Tell me about your boyfriend, Anne.
Well, his name's Daniel. He's 17. Let me see... Well, he has curly blonde hair. He's not very tall - about average. But he's really good-looking.
So, Matt, what's the new girl in class look like?
She's pretty tall, about 170 centimeters. She wears glasses, and has short curly hair. I think she's about 20.
I can't remember. Anne, I think.
So tell me about your cousin, Paul.
No, she has dark brown hair. Everybody likes her. She's an actress.
Really? I'd like to meet her.
